The structure of Gd2Co3CuS4 crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 24 atoms—Gd6 Co9 Cu3 S12—and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers in octahedral coordination with six S neighbors, Cu centers with four S neighbors, and Gd centers with eight S neighbors; each S atom has two Co neighbors. The Co octahedra share edges with one another and with Gd-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, which also share corners and edges with the S polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connected network.
